concern: A teenager with worsening depression, panic attacks, uncontrollable fears and indifference to living or dying, who freezes and can only joke when trying to talk to their parents, and doesn't know who to ask for help.
first_advice: "Having small conversations with your family is helpful, you can explain to them..."
acknowledged_before_advice: The reply opens with "I understand that talking about our feelings can be awkward and using jokes is a way to relieve that awkwardness." This validates the difficulty of opening up to parents. It also affirms that the person is already recognizing their need for help and reaching out.
